title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Scan Run
statement: For a bit string $x$, form the self-delimiting pair whose first component is the pair of the unary head of $x$ and the pair of two empty strings, and whose second component is the unary rest of $x$. Apply the gate-run function to this encoding. The resulting function of $x$ is polynomial-time computable.
